name: Art Blocks
description: Art Blocks is the leading platform for generative art on the blockchain. Connect to discover projects, explore artist catalogs, look up token metadata, check minting availability, build purchase transactions, and query the full Art Blocks dataset via GraphQL.

skills.name: Discover Projects
skills.description: Browse and search Art Blocks projects with filters for artist, vertical, tags, chain, and more. Supports pagination and sorting.
examples: Find Art Blocks projects by artist Dmitri Cherniak
Show me recent Curated projects
What projects are tagged with 'geometry'?

skills.name: Live Mints
skills.description: Find Art Blocks projects currently open for minting (remaining supply), launched within the last 12 months, with an indexed minter in metadata—includes price, supply, and minter type. For older drops or unindexed minters, use discover projects or GraphQL.
examples: What projects are currently minting on Art Blocks?
Are there any open Dutch auctions right now?

skills.name: Upcoming Releases
skills.description: Discover Art Blocks projects scheduled to launch in the future.
examples: What Art Blocks drops are coming up this week?
Show me upcoming Curated releases

skills.name: Token Metadata
skills.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific Art Blocks token including traits, features, media URLs, and ownership info.
examples: Get metadata for Chromie Squiggle #7583
What are the features of Fidenza #313?

skills.name: Artist Lookup
skills.description: Look up an Art Blocks artist by name, slug, or wallet address and retrieve their project catalog.
examples: Tell me about the artist Tyler Hobbs
What projects has Snowfro created?

skills.name: Wallet Portfolio
skills.description: Get a high-level summary or detailed token list for an Art Blocks collector's wallet, including collection stats and valuations.
examples: What Art Blocks tokens does this wallet hold?
Show me a portfolio summary for vitalik.eth

skills.name: Purchase Transactions
skills.description: Build unsigned transactions to mint from set-price Art Blocks projects, with allowlist eligibility checks.
examples: Build a mint transaction for project 450
Am I on the allowlist for this project?

skills.name: GraphQL Query
skills.description: Run raw or assisted GraphQL queries against the full Art Blocks Hasura endpoint. Includes schema introspection, query building, field validation, and optimization tools.
examples: Query all projects with more than 500 mints
What fields are available on the tokens_metadata table?

skills.name: Project Scaffold
skills.description: Generate a starter template for building an Art Blocks generative art project using vanilla JS, p5.js, or Three.js.
examples: Scaffold a new Art Blocks project using p5.js
Create a Three.js starter for Art Blocks

skills.name: PostParams Configuration
skills.description: Discover and configure PostParam values on Art Blocks tokens — artist-defined parameters that collectors can modify after minting.
examples: What postparams are available on this token?
Build a transaction to set postparam values

skills.name: PostParam Hook Development
skills.description: Design, write, test, deploy, and register custom Art Blocks PostParam hook contracts in Solidity — IPMPAugmentHook to inject live on-chain data into tokenData, IPMPConfigureHook to validate or gate collector param changes, or both.
examples: Write an augment hook that injects the token owner address into tokenData
Build a configure hook that requires the collector to own an NFT before setting params
Deploy and register a PostParam hook on Sepolia
